name: Stat card
purpose: The dashboard tile for one headline number: label · value · delta · period on a card surface. Promotes the big-number pattern the fitness-test journeys improvised (sme-payments .flow blocks) into canon, composing the Amount-display money-format primitive (verbatim) on the Cards surface recipe. One tile, one claim — a board is a grid of these.

props.name: label
props.$note: .t-cm-caption at 0.6 ink; names the metric, sentence case.

props.name: value
props.$note: The Amount-display primitive markup unchanged: figure composites, tabular-nums, currency before value no space (copy-025), U+2212 minus. Plain counts render without currency.

props.name: size
props.$note: display = .t-cm-figure-4 (32px) · compact = .t-cm-figure-3 (24px, T-D14) for dense boards.
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C2 -- bind:icon-ramp-map. Size enum binds to the icon-scale ramp. CROSS-REFERENCE (s143-D1(A), Dave, 2026-08-10): this prop's own $note also binds to TYPOGRAPHY composites (.t-cm-figure-3/4) -- size is TWO ADDITIVE AXES (icon scale + type scale), not a conflict. No safe rung correspondence; bound to the bare family. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: delta
props.$note: Signed change + direction word ('+12.4% up'); .t-cm-figure-6 in INK. Direction = arrow + sign + wording, never colour alone.
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C12 -- confirm-set. co-mentioned array CONFIRMED as the PROP's (not the component's), Dave's set-confirm sitting. Existing binds array verified to match the ruled proposed_binds exactly. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: direction
props.$note: R-D5: directional deltas are red/green ONLY. The arrow glyph wears rag/success or rag/error (3:1 floor, R-D6 A′ — labelled); flat = no arrow, 'No change'.
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C10 -- no-bind:structural-param. Structural/positional parameter, no token consequence. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

variants.name: flat
variants.use: No movement: 'No change', full ink, no arrow.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — label .t-cm-caption · value .t-cm-figure-4/.t-cm-figure-3 · delta .t-cm-figure-6 · period .t-cm-legal
tokens.value: text/default — monochrome money format (the Amount-display atom's scope)
tokens.delta-arrow: rag/success / rag/error (R-D5 red/green only; 5.0/4.8 · 6.02/3.66 vs the surface — ≥3:1 both modes)
tokens.delta-text: text/default — NEVER coloured (dark rag/error 3.66 fails 4.5 as text)
tokens.$survey: Promoted from fitness-test improvisations; Amount-display + Cards mined, untouched.

motion.none: Passive tile — no interactive states, no press physics markers. A linked/tappable variant is a receipt question, not improvised.

responsive.rule: Board grid auto-fills minmax(240px,1fr); tiles are fluid; tabular figures keep columns aligned.

mustNotNeighbour: A chart making the identical claim in the same view (pick one headline form)

accessibility.role: role="group" + aria-label naming metric and period, so the tile reads as one unit.
accessibility.name: aria-label carries 'metric, period'; arrows aria-hidden (sign + wording carry direction).
accessibility.keyboard: Nothing focusable in the passive form.
accessibility.nonText: Delta arrows ≥3:1 vs the surface both modes (1.4.11); direction never rests on colour alone (arrow + sign + wording).

antiPatterns: Coloured delta TEXT (dark rag/error fails 4.5 as text — the arrow wears the colour)
Amber as a direction (R-D5: red/green only; amber is status, not direction)
Colour as the only direction channel (arrow + sign + wording, always)
Re-implementing the money format locally (compose the Amount-display primitive)
A tile making two claims (one metric per card)
Proportional (non-tabular) figures in a board (columns shear)
